title: Exact derived inverse image over an arbitrary pro-etale ring sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], using their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For any sheaf of rings $R$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, not necessarily commutative, let $f^{-1}R$ be its ring inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define $P_{f,R}:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(f^{-1}R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by applying the sheaf inverse image to the underlying abelian sheaf and the action map, with the canonical finite-product comparison. Equivalently this is the module-sheaf pullback along the ring adjunction unit, transported to the small model of the site and back. There is no extension to an independently specified ring. This inverse image is additive and exact over its actual inverse-image ring. Use the standard localization at quasi-isomorphisms for the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and define $D(P_{f,R}):D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(f^{-1}R))$ to be the functor induced by applying $P_{f,R}$ termwise to cochain complexes and their maps. Thus $D(P_{f,R})\circ Q_R$ is canonically isomorphic to $Q_{f^{-1}R}\circ\operatorname{CoCh}(P_{f,R})$. This construction has no Noetherianity, stratification, boundedness, commutativity or flatness hypothesis.
